direction_review.title: Conditional experiment readout
direction_review.person: Product experimentation lead and quality owner
direction_review.context: Four week randomized onboarding test with a quality guardrail.
direction_review.task: Choose whether to expand treatment beyond a limited rollout.
direction_review.decision: Continue only as a limited rollout while the quality and retention caveats remain open.
direction_review.current_truth: Treatment conversion is higher in the observed sample; long term retention is unknown.
direction_review.tone: Measured and conditional; sample limits stay adjacent to the treatment evidence.
direction_review.misunderstanding: The trend may be read as proof of durable lift without its sample caveat.
